fields.statement: QA cycle 1 at a3dd859: built rhiza with go build to a scratch path and ran it by hand in a scratch repo with a bare origin.git, a fake rex/claude (roles doing real rhiza writes) and a fake gh (no network). rhiza run start <record> --workflow plan succeeded through gate -> open-pr. The branch's last commit was 'Render the plan' with Change: <cs> and Actor: trailers, holding every .rhiza/log entry the run's agents wrote plus .rhiza/rendered; git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all was empty and rhiza check printed ok with no manual render.

QA cycle 1 at a3dd859: built rhiza with go build to a scratch path and ran it by hand in a scratch repo with a bare origin.git, a fake rex/claude (roles doing real rhiza writes) and a fake gh (no network). The run pushed cs/plan-reports and called gh pr create once with --title Plan reports; the body had '# Plan of run', Round 1 with 'confirmed f1 on export-csv ... — confirmed: ...', Round 2 'No findings.', Questions 'None.' and the Gate listing both change sets with states. In a second run held at wait-pr (CI pending), a new commit and RHIZA_RUN=<run> rhiza ship open-pr pushed the new head to origin, called gh pr edit 7 --body-file (no second pr create) with the refreshed body ('at step wait-pr'), and said 'Updated PR #7'. A run with red CI failed at pr-green and never called gh pr merge.

QA cycle 1 at a3dd859: built rhiza with go build to a scratch path and ran it by hand in a scratch repo with a bare origin.git, a fake rex/claude (roles doing real rhiza writes) and a fake gh (no network). With green checks the plan run ran wait-pr, pr-green, merge ('pr merge 7 --squash --match-head-commit <pushed head>', no --admin/--auto/--delete-branch) and close-out: worktree repo.plan-reports and cs/plan-reports gone locally and on origin, main fast-forwarded to the merged head, .git/rhiza/ship empty; the planned change set stayed proposed (run landed nothing). A following ship-change run on that change set opened PR #8 and its merge step called 'pr merge 8 --squash --match-head-commit <head>', reported a merge_commit and no already_merged; ship state then held pr 8.
